On. Directional tones play as you approa.en: On. Directional tones play as you approach walls.

On. Directional tones play as you approa.it: Attivato. Toni direzionali si attivano quando ti avvicini ai muri.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.de: Ein. Richtungstöne ertönen, wenn du dich Wänden näherst.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.es: Activado. Suenan tonos direccionales al acercarte a las paredes.

Off. No directional wall feedback..pt: Desligado. Sem retorno direcional de paredes.

On. A click plays for each tile of playe.en: On. A click plays for each tile of player movement.

On. A click plays for each tile of playe.fr: Activé. Un clic retentit à chaque case de déplacement du joueur.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.it: Attivato. Un clic suona per ogni casella di movimento del giocatore.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.de: Ein. Bei jedem Feld der Spielerbewegung ertönt ein Klick.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.es: Activado. Suena un clic por cada casilla de movimiento del jugador.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.ko: 켜짐. 플레이어가 한 칸 이동할 때마다 클릭음이 재생됩니다.

On. A click plays for each tile of playe.pt: Ligado. Um clique toca a cada quadro de movimento do jogador.

Off. No per-tile movement sound..pt: Desligado. Sem som de movimento por quadro.

On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.en: On. Audio beacon is the primary navigation aid; turn-by-turn pathfinding is disabled.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ja: オン。音声ビーコンが主なナビゲーション手段になり、ターンバイターンの経路案内は無効になります。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.fr: Activé. La balise audio est l'aide à la navigation principale ; le guidage pas à pas est désactivé.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.it: Attivato. Il segnale audio è il principale ausilio alla navigazione; la guida passo passo è disattivata.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.de: Ein. Das Audiosignal ist die primäre Navigationshilfe; die schrittweise Wegführung ist deaktiviert.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.es: Activado. La baliza de audio es la ayuda de navegación principal; la guía paso a paso está desactivada.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ko: 켜짐. 오디오 비콘이 주요 내비게이션 수단이 되며, 단계별 경로 안내는 비활성화됩니다.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.zht: 開啟。音訊信標為主要導航方式；逐步路徑導引將停用。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.zhc: 开启。音频信标为主要导航方式；逐步路径导引将停用。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ru: Вкл. Звуковой маяк — основное средство навигации; пошаговая прокладка пути отключена.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.th: เปิด สัญญาณเสียงเป็นตัวช่วยนำทางหลัก การนำทางแบบทีละขั้นจะถูกปิด
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.pt: Ligado. O sinalizador de áudio é o principal auxílio de navegação; a orientação passo a passo é desativada.

Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.fr: Désactivé. Le guidage pas à pas est utilisé pour la navigation.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.it: Disattivato. Per la navigazione si usa la guida passo passo.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.de: Aus. Zur Navigation wird die schrittweise Wegführung verwendet.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.es: Desactivado. Se usa la guía paso a paso para la navegación.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ko: 꺼짐. 내비게이션에 단계별 경로 안내를 사용합니다.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.zht: 關閉。導航使用逐步路徑導引。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.zhc: 关闭。导航使用逐步路径导引。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ru: Выкл. Для навигации используется пошаговая прокладка пути.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.th: ปิด ใช้การนำทางแบบทีละขั้นในการนำทาง
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.pt: Desligado. A orientação passo a passo é usada para navegação.

On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.en: On. Entity cycling shows only entities reachable via pathfinding.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ja: オン。エンティティの切り替えでは、経路探索で到達可能なものだけが表示されます。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.fr: Activé. Le défilement des entités n'affiche que celles accessibles par le calcul d'itinéraire.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.it: Attivato. Lo scorrimento delle entità mostra solo quelle raggiungibili tramite il calcolo del percorso.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.de: Ein. Beim Durchschalten werden nur per Wegfindung erreichbare Objekte angezeigt.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.es: Activado. El cambio de entidades solo muestra las alcanzables mediante el cálculo de ruta.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ko: 켜짐. 개체 전환 시 경로 탐색으로 도달 가능한 개체만 표시됩니다.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.zht: 開啟。切換實體時僅顯示可透過尋路抵達的實體。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.zhc: 开启。切换实体时仅显示可通过寻路抵达的实体。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ru: Вкл. При переборе объектов показываются только достижимые по маршруту.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.th: เปิด การวนดูสิ่งของจะแสดงเฉพาะสิ่งที่ไปถึงได้ด้วยการค้นหาเส้นทาง
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.pt: Ligado. A rotação de entidades mostra apenas as alcançáveis por cálculo de rota.

Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.en: Off. All entities appear when cycling, including unreachable ones.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ja: オフ。切り替え時に、到達できないものも含めてすべてのエンティティが表示されます。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.fr: Désactivé. Toutes les entités apparaissent lors du défilement, y compris celles inaccessibles.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.it: Disattivato. Tutte le entità appaiono durante lo scorrimento, comprese quelle irraggiungibili.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.de: Aus. Beim Durchschalten erscheinen alle Objekte, auch unerreichbare.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.es: Desactivado. Todas las entidades aparecen al cambiar, incluidas las inalcanzables.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ko: 꺼짐. 전환 시 도달할 수 없는 개체를 포함해 모든 개체가 표시됩니다.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.zht: 關閉。切換時顯示所有實體，包括無法抵達的。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.zhc: 关闭。切换时显示所有实体，包括无法抵达的。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ru: Выкл. При переборе показываются все объекты, включая недостижимые.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.th: ปิด แสดงสิ่งของทั้งหมดเมื่อวนดู รวมถึงสิ่งที่ไปไม่ถึง
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.pt: Desligado. Todas as entidades aparecem ao alternar, incluindo as inacessíveis.

On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.en: On. Multiple exits leading to the same destination collapse to the closest one.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ja: オン。同じ目的地につながる複数の出口は、最も近い1つにまとめられます。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.fr: Activé. Les sorties multiples menant à la même destination sont regroupées sur la plus proche.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.it: Attivato. Le uscite multiple verso la stessa destinazione vengono ridotte a quella più vicina.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.de: Ein. Mehrere Ausgänge zum selben Ziel werden auf den nächstgelegenen zusammengefasst.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.es: Activado. Varias salidas que llevan al mismo destino se reducen a la más cercana.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ko: 켜짐. 같은 목적지로 이어지는 여러 출구는 가장 가까운 하나로 합쳐집니다.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.zht: 開啟。通往相同目的地的多個出口將合併為最近的一個。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.zhc: 开启。通往相同目的地的多个出口将合并为最近的一个。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ru: Вкл. Несколько выходов к одной цели сводятся к ближайшему.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.th: เปิด ทางออกหลายทางที่ไปยังจุดหมายเดียวกันจะรวมเหลือทางที่ใกล้ที่สุด
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.pt: Ligado. Várias saídas que levam ao mesmo destino são reduzidas à mais próxima.

Off. All map exits appear in navigation..en: Off. All map exits appear in navigation.
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..ja: オフ。すべてのマップ出口がナビゲーションに表示されます。
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..fr: Désactivé. Toutes les sorties de la carte apparaissent dans la navigation.
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..it: Disattivato. Tutte le uscite della mappa appaiono nella navigazione.
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..de: Aus. Alle Kartenausgänge erscheinen in der Navigation.
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..es: Desactivado. Todas las salidas del mapa aparecen en la navegación.
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..ko: 꺼짐. 모든 맵 출구가 내비게이션에 표시됩니다.
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..zht: 關閉。所有地圖出口都會顯示在導航中。
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..zhc: 关闭。所有地图出口都会显示在导航中。
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..ru: Выкл. Все выходы карты отображаются в навигации.
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..th: ปิด ทางออกของแผนที่ทั้งหมดจะปรากฏในการนำทาง
Off. All map exits appear in navigation..pt: Desligado. Todas as saídas do mapa aparecem na navegação.

On. Layer transition entities are hidden.de: Ein. Objekte für Ebenenübergänge werden in der Navigation ausgeblendet.
On. Layer transition entities are hidden.es: Activado. Las entidades de transición de capa se ocultan en la navegación.
On. Layer transition entities are hidden.ko: 켜짐. 레이어 전환 개체가 내비게이션에서 숨겨집니다.
On. Layer transition entities are hidden.zht: 開啟。圖層轉換實體將從導航中隱藏。
On. Layer transition entities are hidden.zhc: 开启。图层转换实体将从导航中隐藏。
On. Layer transition entities are hidden.ru: Вкл. Объекты перехода между слоями скрыты из навигации.

On. Layer transition entities are hidden.pt: Ligado. As entidades de transição de camada ficam ocultas na navegação.

Off. Layer transition entities appear in.zht: 關閉。圖層轉換實體會顯示在導航中。

Off. Layer transition entities appear in.ru: Выкл. Объекты перехода между слоями отображаются в навигации.
Off. Layer transition entities appear in.th: ปิด สิ่งของที่ใช้เปลี่ยนเลเยอร์จะปรากฏในการนำทาง
Off. Layer transition entities appear in.pt: Desligado. As entidades de transição de camada aparecem na navegação.

On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.it: Attivato. L3 e R3 vengono passati al gioco (corsa automatica e attivazione incontri). Le funzioni del mod passano alla modalità mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.de: Ein. L3 und R3 werden an das Spiel weitergegeben (Auto-Dash und Begegnungen umschalten). Mod-Funktionen wechseln in den Mod-Modus.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.es: Activado. L3 y R3 pasan al juego (autocarrera y alternar encuentros). Las funciones del mod pasan al modo mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ko: 켜짐. L3와 R3는 게임으로 전달됩니다(자동 달리기 및 인카운트 전환). 모드 기능은 모드 모드로 이동합니다.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.zht: 開啟。L3與R3將傳遞給遊戲（自動奔跑與遇敵切換）。Mod功能移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.zhc: 开启。L3与R3将传递给游戏（自动奔跑与遇敌切换）。Mod功能移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ru: Вкл. L3 и R3 передаются игре (авто-бег и переключение сражений). Функции мода переходят в режим мода.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.th: เปิด L3 และ R3 จะส่งต่อไปยังเกม (วิ่งอัตโนมัติและสลับการเจอศัตรู) ฟังก์ชันม็อดจะย้ายไปที่โหมดม็อด
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.pt: Ligado. L3 e R3 são repassados ao jogo (corrida automática e alternar encontros). As funções do mod vão para o modo mod.

Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.en: Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 toggles pathfinding filter; game cannot see them.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ja: オフ。L3はビーコンナビゲーションを切り替え、R3は経路探索フィルターを切り替えます。ゲームはこれらを認識しません。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.fr: Désactivé. L3 bascule la navigation par balise ; R3 bascule le filtre d'itinéraire ; le jeu ne les voit pas.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.it: Disattivato. L3 attiva/disattiva la navigazione a segnale; R3 attiva/disattiva il filtro percorso; il gioco non li rileva.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.de: Aus. L3 schaltet die Signalnavigation um; R3 schaltet den Wegfindungsfilter um; das Spiel sieht sie nicht.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.es: Desactivado. L3 alterna la navegación por baliza; R3 alterna el filtro de ruta; el juego no los detecta.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ko: 꺼짐. L3는 비콘 내비게이션을, R3는 경로 탐색 필터를 전환합니다. 게임은 이를 인식하지 못합니다.

Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.zhc: 关闭。L3切换信标导航；R3切换寻路筛选；游戏无法检测到它们。

On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.en: On. Descriptions and stats announce automatically on focus for items, magic, equipment, and shops.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ja: オン。アイテム、魔法、装備、ショップで、フォーカス時に説明とステータスが自動的に読み上げられます。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.fr: Activé. Les descriptions et statistiques sont annoncées automatiquement au focus pour les objets, la magie, l'équipement et les boutiques.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.it: Attivato. Descrizioni e statistiche vengono annunciate automaticamente al focus per oggetti, magie, equipaggiamento e negozi.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.de: Ein. Beschreibungen und Werte werden bei Fokus für Gegenstände, Magie, Ausrüstung und Shops automatisch angesagt.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.es: Activado. Las descripciones y estadísticas se anuncian automáticamente al enfocar objetos, magia, equipo y tiendas.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ko: 켜짐. 아이템, 마법, 장비, 상점에서 포커스 시 설명과 능력치가 자동으로 안내됩니다.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.zht: 開啟。在道具、魔法、裝備與商店中，聚焦時自動播報說明與數值。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.zhc: 开启。在道具、魔法、装备与商店中，聚焦时自动播报说明与数值。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ru: Вкл. Описания и характеристики озвучиваются автоматически при фокусе для предметов, магии, снаряжения и магазинов.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.th: เปิด คำอธิบายและค่าสถานะจะถูกประกาศอัตโนมัติเมื่อโฟกัสที่ไอเทม เวทมนตร์ อุปกรณ์ และร้านค้า
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.pt: Ligado. Descrições e atributos são anunciados automaticamente ao focar itens, magia, equipamento e lojas.

On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.en: On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks the current destination.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ja: オン。ビーコンを再開すると、現在の目的地も再度読み上げられます。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.fr: Activé. Relancer la balise réénonce aussi la destination actuelle.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.it: Attivato. Riavviando il segnale viene riannunciata anche la destinazione attuale.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.de: Ein. Beim Neustart des Signals wird auch das aktuelle Ziel erneut angesagt.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.es: Activado. Reiniciar la baliza también vuelve a anunciar el destino actual.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ko: 켜짐. 비콘을 다시 시작하면 현재 목적지도 다시 안내됩니다.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.zht: 開啟。重新啟動信標時也會再次播報目前的目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.zhc: 开启。重新启动信标时也会再次播报当前的目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ru: Вкл. Перезапуск маяка также повторно озвучивает текущую цель.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.th: เปิด การเริ่มสัญญาณใหม่จะพูดจุดหมายปัจจุบันซ้ำด้วย
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.pt: Ligado. Reiniciar o sinalizador também reanuncia o destino atual.

Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.en: Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings, without speaking.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.ja: オフ。ビーコンを再開しても、音が鳴るだけで読み上げはされません。
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.fr: Désactivé. Relancer la balise ne fait que réémettre le signal, sans énoncé.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.it: Disattivato. Riavviando il segnale viene solo riemesso il ping, senza annuncio.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.de: Aus. Beim Neustart des Signals ertönt nur erneut der Ping, ohne Ansage.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.es: Desactivado. Reiniciar la baliza solo vuelve a emitir el sonido, sin anunciar.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.ko: 꺼짐. 비콘을 다시 시작하면 핑만 다시 울리고 안내는 하지 않습니다.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.zht: 關閉。重新啟動信標只會再次發出提示音，不會播報。
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.zhc: 关闭。重新启动信标只会再次发出提示音，不会播报。
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.ru: Выкл. Перезапуск маяка только повторяет сигнал, без озвучивания.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.th: ปิด การเริ่มสัญญาณใหม่จะส่งเสียงปิงอีกครั้งเท่านั้น โดยไม่พูด
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.pt: Desligado. Reiniciar o sinalizador apenas emite o sinal novamente, sem falar.
